title: GifFramesParams
description: `gif.from_frames`: gifski over the PNG frames in `frames_dir`, in file-name order.

allow_larger.description:
Write the result even when it is not smaller than the input. Optimise ops default to false
(and answer `already_smaller`); resize, crop, convert and encode ops default to true.

frames_dir.description: Folder of PNG frames (for example what ffmpeg extracted). Falls back to `input`.

in_place.description:
Allow `output` to equal `input` (or be omitted). The engine writes a temporary file in the
same folder and renames it over the input, keeping its mode, creation date and extended
attributes.

repeat.description: Loop count; 0 or absent loops forever.

strip.description: Remove metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, comments, text chunks) except what `keep` lists.

width.description: Maximum output width; height follows the aspect ratio unless given.

oneOf.description:
The colour profile (ICC, and PNG sRGB/gAMA/cHRM/cICP). Dropping it changes how wide-gamut
images look.
The EXIF orientation tag, rewritten as a minimal EXIF block.
